environment.description: Same NestJS microservice on ECS Fargate. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL (regional scope) with a custom rule group priority 1 containing a ByteMatchStatement rule inspecting the request Body (first 8KB, content type APPLICATION_JSON) using the JsonBody match scope targeting All paths. The rule uses a RegexPatternSet reference matching field names: (isAdmin|role|accountStatus|apiKey|creditLimit) with SearchString in Values match and action BLOCK. Additionally, the WebACL includes AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 5 with SizeRestrictions_BODY rule in COUNT mode (not block). The custom rule group's ByteMatch uses FieldToMatch: JsonBody with MatchScope: ALL and InvalidFallbackBehavior: MATCH (meaning malformed JSON also gets blocked). CloudWatch metrics confirm the custom rule fires on payloads containing privilege-escalation field names.

waf_rules.name: BlockMassAssignmentFields
waf_rules.statement: ByteMatchStatement with JsonBody MatchScope:ALL inspecting field keys against RegexPatternSet containing: ^(isAdmin|role|accountStatus|apiKey|creditLimit)$

config.network: Private subnet, ALB in public subnet
